value.rationale: For the canonical Frobenius lift \(x\mapsto x^p\pmod {p^2}\) from Heilbronn exponential sums, the theorem treats all \(p^p\) residue-digit perturbations and completely classifies their shared Fourier-zero set and all exponential partners. The closed counts \(p^{p^2+p}\) and \(p^3(p-1)\), alongside the Fourier-support fraction \(p^{-1}-p^{-2}+p^{-3}\to0\), reveal the coexistence of ambient convolution rank collapse with many complete spectral bases. This goes beyond the known fact that a graph tiles by vertical translation.
